# Bonny & Bright

> An interactive personal skincare platform that uses a visitor's skin needs, existing products, budget, and trust information to shape routines and product discovery.

## Static overview

- [About Bonny & Bright](./about/): JavaScript-free overview of the product, features, and prototype limitations.

## Main application areas

- Guided skin-profile onboarding
- Routine Builder and personalised recommendations
- My Shelf for existing products
- Product discovery, shopping, trust centre, and product detail screens
- Skin Journey, subscriptions, store locator, account settings, and an admin dashboard

## Deployment note

The public site is a front-end prototype. Demo activity is stored in each visitor's browser unless optional Supabase and Stripe production services are configured.
